title: Implement Request Body Parsing
description: This feature is crucial for handling JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, enabling yantraverse to support a wider range of APIs and applications. It will provide a robust way to parse request bodies, handling errors and edge cases. This will improve the overall usability and flexibility of the framework
testCases: Test error handling for invalid request bodies
acceptance: Request body parsing works correctly for JSON and URL-encoded bodies, handles errors and edge cases, and is fully tested
reason: Business justification: improves framework usability and flexibility, technical justification: fills a critical gap in the framework's functionality
